title: SIDESTORY: COME CATASTROPHES OR WAKES OF VULTURES RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: COME CATASTROPHES OR WAKES OF VULTURES RERUN
DURATION: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Anemic Platform] & [Black Landship]
Duration: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 10, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Prize Exchange Office]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Prize Exchange Office] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Coldshot], BSW Safehouse Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Shoddy Fuel, etc.
[Shack by the Tower]
DURATION: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Shoddy Fuel by clearing event stages and completing [Prize Exchange Office] missions. Shoddy Fuel can be used to redeem items from [Shack by the Tower].
REWARDS: Coldshot's token, BSW Safehouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Jessica the Liberated, Almond, and Coldshot will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be available in [Side Story] from March 14, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – CLANK LIBERTY
DURATION: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Clank Liberty], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting.
★★★★★★: Jessica the Liberated
★★★★★: Almond / Rockrock

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting] that features the same Operators as the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 RAYTHEAN STRIKER SERIES NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
Raythean Striker Series - Dawnbreak for Coldshot
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – BSW SAFEHOUSE
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
Duration: February 28, 2025, 10:00 - March 14, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
